subject: groq-code-cli
title: Never-auto-approvable dangerous tier separated from session-auto-approvable tier
one_why: canAutoApprove requires !isDangerous, so session auto-approve can never silently unlock execute_command/delete_file, and a missing approval callback denies by default; small, clean policy shape worth mirroring, though it is untested here.

subject: groq-code-cli
title: No path containment on read/create/edit; delete guard bypassable via sibling prefix
one_why: With session auto-approve on, the model can read_file then edit_file any absolute path (~/.bashrc, ~/.ssh/authorized_keys); delete_file's startsWith check admits /work/proj-evil when cwd is /work/proj -- approvals bind by tool name, never by path scope.

subject: groq-code-cli
title: ava files glob orphans 3 of 4 test files; no CI ever runs tests
evidence: package.json:53-56 (files: ["src/**/*.test.ts"]) vs test/agent-context-load.test.ts, test/context-generator.test.ts, test/init-command.test.ts; only .github/workflows/stale.yaml exists
one_why: npm test runs only src/tests/proxy-config.test.ts; the loop, approval gate, and tool dispatch have zero coverage and no CI job would catch regressions even in the tests that do exist.

subject: groq-code-cli
title: Unbounded message history; overflow surfaces as generic retry-forever error overlay
evidence: src/core/agent.ts:266-541 (messages array only grows; no compaction anywhere in src/), retry path src/core/agent.ts:487-517
one_why: No compaction, trim, or context-window check exists; a context-length 400 enters the same onError retry loop and 'retry' re-sends the identical oversized payload -- worse than codel's crude >30k-chars ask-the-user because there is no detection at all, only usage display.

subject: groq-code-cli
title: Deterministic no-LLM /init project-context generator with env-var overrides
evidence: src/utils/context.ts:35-80 (walk maxDepth 3 / maxEntries 1500, language histogram, package facts, tree -> .groq/context.md + .json); auto-load + GROQ_CONTEXT_FILE/DIR/LIMIT trim src/core/agent.ts:66-86
one_why: Seeds a repo-map context file without spending a model call, keeps a machine-readable JSON twin, and the GROQ_CONTEXT_* env trio makes it testable (test/agent-context-load.test.ts) -- a cheaper alternative to LLM-summarized AGENTS.md bootstrapping.

subject: groq-code-cli
title: Debug mode writes masked curl repro plus full request JSON per API call
evidence: src/core/agent.ts:664-680 (generateCurlCommand, key masked to 8+8 chars) invoked at src/core/agent.ts:325
one_why: Every request becomes a runnable curl against a saved body file, making provider-side bug reproduction trivial without a proxy; note the request JSON dumps the full conversation to cwd, so it should ship with a redaction pass if adopted.
